headline_marked: De Paul pays tribute as [[Lionel Messi's father passes away]] at 68
headline: De Paul pays tribute as Lionel Messi's father passes away at 68
summary: Inter Miami midfielder Rodrigo De Paul dedicated his goal to the Argentine star's father, Jorge Messi, who died in Argentina.
details: Lionel Messi's father, Jorge Messi, has passed away in Argentina at the age of 68. The football world is mourning the loss of the man who was a primary influence on Leo's legendary career.
Rodrigo De Paul showed a heartfelt tribute to his close friend and captain during an Inter Miami match against Monterrey in the Leagues Cup on Saturday.
After scoring a powerful strike from outside the box in the 32nd minute, De Paul removed his shirt to reveal Messi's iconic No. 10 jersey underneath, dedicating the goal to the grieving star.
Before the match, both teams observed a minute of silence for Jorge Messi, and Inter Miami supporters displayed signs reading 'Stay strong, Leo' to show their solidarity.
Messi was absent from the game as he traveled back to his hometown of Rosario, Argentina, to bid farewell to his father.
Despite De Paul's early lead, Inter Miami eventually lost the match 2-1 after goals from Hugo Cuypers and Diego Rossi.
caption:
A touching tribute on the pitch. Rodrigo De Paul reveals Messi's No. 10 jersey after scoring to honor the passing of Lionel Messi's father.

Lionel Messi's father, Jorge Messi, has passed away in Argentina at the age of 68. The football world is mourning the loss of the man who was a primary influence on Leo's legendary career.

Rodrigo De Paul showed a heartfelt tribute to his close friend and captain during an Inter Miami match against Monterrey in the Leagues Cup on Saturday.

After scoring a powerful strike from outside the box in the 32nd minute, De Paul removed his shirt to reveal Messi's iconic No. 10 jersey underneath, dedicating the goal to the grieving star.

Before the match, both teams observed a minute of silence for Jorge Messi, and Inter Miami supporters displayed signs reading 'Stay strong, Leo' to show their solidarity.

Messi was absent from the game as he traveled back to his hometown of Rosario, Argentina, to bid farewell to his father.

Despite De Paul's early lead, Inter Miami eventually lost the match 2-1 after goals from Hugo Cuypers and Diego Rossi.

headline_marked: Obaidul Quader [[told Palak to slow internet]] during July uprising
headline: Obaidul Quader told Palak to slow internet during July uprising
summary: A recorded phone conversation submitted to the International Crimes Tribunal-2 reveals instructions to restrict internet services during the 2024 protests.
details: Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader instructed then state minister for ICT Zunaid Ahmed Palak to slow down internet services during the July uprising in 2024.
The evidence, a recorded phone conversation, was submitted to the International Crimes Tribunal-2 today.
In the recording, Palak responded by stating that he would need approval from then prime minister Sheikh Hasina before taking the step.
The prosecution presented this recording as key evidence on the third day of arguments in a crimes against humanity case against Quader and six others.
The prosecution emphasized that the conversation regarding the control of internet services during the uprising is a critical piece of evidence in the legal proceedings.
caption:
A leaked recording reveals Obaidul Quader's order to slow the internet during the July uprising.

Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader instructed then state minister for ICT Zunaid Ahmed Palak to slow down internet services during the July uprising in 2024.

The evidence, a recorded phone conversation, was submitted to the International Crimes Tribunal-2 today.

In the recording, Palak responded by stating that he would need approval from then prime minister Sheikh Hasina before taking the step.

The prosecution presented this recording as key evidence on the third day of arguments in a crimes against humanity case against Quader and six others.

The prosecution emphasized that the conversation regarding the control of internet services during the uprising is a critical piece of evidence in the legal proceedings.
